resources.string: The address you open Polaris at in a browser.

That address answers, but it isn\'t Polaris.
Polaris is starting there. Try again in a minute.
That address sends you somewhere else. Use the address Polaris opens at.
Nothing answers at that address. Check it, and that this phone is online.
%1$s can\'t be reached from this phone right now.
This file can\'t be saved from the app yet.
No app on this phone opens that link.
Download it and open the file to install it over this version.
Android puts Polaris to sleep to save battery, so messages and calls can arrive late. Let it run in the background to get them as they come.
This cannot be opened right now. Try again in a moment.
Open a door from your home screen
It did not open. Try again.
There are no doors you can open on this Polaris.
Your doors could not be read. Check your connection and try again.
Open Polaris and sign in first.
Each one stays signed in on its own. Tap one to open it.
This phone signs out of it and forgets it. You can add it again later.
Your answer could not be sent. Answer from the device signing in instead.
That link isn\'t a Polaris page.
That code isn\'t a list of Polaris servers.
Every server on that list is already on this phone.
This Polaris isn\'t on this phone yet. Add it to open the link here.
Have Polaris on a computer? Scan its servers QR with your camera to add them all.
Your Polaris Vault logins in other apps and browsers on this phone, and new ones saved as you sign in.
Set a screen lock on this phone first. Your vault opens with it, so a phone picked up locked opens nothing.
Connect this phone to the vault on %1$s. You approve it on the vault page, with no master password typed here.
Approve this phone on the vault page. Code: %1$s
Approved. Confirm it\'s you to keep the vault on this phone.
The request was declined on the vault page.
The request ran out before it was approved. Connect again.
The approval arrived but couldn\'t be opened. Connect again.
Your Polaris server didn\'t answer. Check the connection and try again.
Connected to %1$s, synced %2$s. Turn on autofill to use it in other apps.
Polaris fills logins from %1$s in other apps. Synced %2$s.
Couldn\'t sync. Your Polaris server didn\'t answer.
This phone stops filling your logins and forgets its copy of the vault. Your vault itself is not changed.
This phone\'s vault connection ended. Open Vault autofill in Polaris to connect again.
Confirm it\'s you to fill your login
Search by name, username or site
That login has no username or password to fill.
%1$s already has a login named %2$s. Its old password is kept in the history.
That login changed somewhere else first. Sync and save it again.
Couldn\'t save to Polaris Vault. Your server didn\'t accept it.
Allow Polaris to set up the VPN when the phone asks.
That place didn\'t answer. Try another location.
That place can\'t be reached right now. Check this phone is online, or try another location.
Sign in to Polaris to connect.
Pick a location in Polaris first.
Your account can\'t use the VPN any more.
You have used all your VPN devices. Remove one in Polaris.
That location is full. Try another.
